Practice 01

Raw land becomes an income-producing asset when it is structured before capital is committed.

In short

HAYKALAH takes real estate from raw land to an income-producing asset. We test the use, model the economics, design the capital stack and the vehicle, and manage the technical parties through delivery. The practice serves landowners, developers, family offices and government entities, drawing on a record that runs from central Makkah and the Holy Sites to downtown Jeddah.

What we do

  • Market research and highest-and-best-use studies for land and buildings.

  • Feasibility studies, financial models and valuation reports.

  • Land assembly through in-kind contributions, so landowners join the project as equity partners.

  • Capital stacks that combine equity, in-kind land and Shariah-compliant bank debt.

  • SPV, joint-venture and real-estate fund structures. Any fund is set up and managed by a CMA-authorised manager.

  • Bank processes: the banking document, the request for offers and a like-for-like comparison of terms.

  • Management of the technical parties: engineers, contractors and sales agents.

How we create value

  • 02

    Monetization

    We take real estate from raw land to an income-producing asset, and execute or supervise each workstream until the asset earns.

  • 03

    Optimization

    We test the land with highest-and-best-use and feasibility studies before capital is committed, and compare bank terms like for like before a facility is recommended.

How we work

  1. 01

    Test the land

    Market research and feasibility show whether there is demand and whether the project works.

  2. 02

    Model and value

    One financial model of record and a valuation set the funding need under each scenario.

  3. 03

    Structure the capital

    We design the vehicle, the landowners’ in-kind share, the equity and the bank terms.

  4. 04

    Bring in capital

    Investors and lenders receive an information memorandum and a term sheet; any regulated offer runs through a CMA-authorised institution.

  5. 05

    Deliver and monitor

    HAYKALAH executes or supervises each workstream and reports to the board until the asset earns.

Questions

What is Musataha, and how is it used in Saudi real estate?

Musataha is a right to build on and use land owned by another party for an agreed term. The landowner keeps title while a project company builds and runs the asset. An Ijara or a Sukuk structure can sit on top of it.

Can landowners contribute land instead of cash?

Yes. In an in-kind contribution the land is valued and exchanged for equity in the project company. HAYKALAH has modeled this in central Makkah, where landowners’ land formed part of the project’s capital.

Does HAYKALAH set up or manage real-estate funds?

HAYKALAH designs fund structures and can hold a seat on a fund board. Establishing and managing an investment fund is a CMA-regulated activity, carried out by a CMA-authorised institution engaged for the transaction.

Does HAYKALAH work in Makkah and Madinah?

Yes. The record includes central-area land and pilgrim housing in Makkah, hotels near the Haram and in central Madinah, and financing and pricing for the Holy Sites.

Tell us about the land or building you want to put to work. We can start under an NDA.
